status: Locally verified pressure and raster-alpha foundations; final nine-case browser correctness suite passed.

parity.claim: No ZBrush brush, pressure-response, alpha-projection, native-device, or complete feature-family parity claim. No proprietary source or bundled alpha assets used.

implementation_contract.mouse_default: Full pressure; browser mouse pressure 0.5 is ignored.
implementation_contract.pressure_response: Linear strength scaling; optional linear radius scaling; finite samples clamp to 0..1; zero pressure makes every brush an exact no-op.
implementation_contract.alpha: Immutable shared grayscale 8-bit bitmap; white weight 1, black/transparent weight 0, bilinear sampling, top-left row origin, scalar multiplication within the existing radial footprint.
implementation_contract.rgba_to_grayscale: Rounded (77R+150G+29B)/256, then rounded multiplication by opacity/255. Weights operate directly in supplied channel space.
implementation_contract.orientation: Surface plane based on coherent brush normal and projected camera-right tangent. Counterclockwise rotation; mirror both original axes across X.
implementation_contract.persistent_level_integration: Host disables automatic local refinement when more than one persistent subdivision level exists; all five surface geometry tools still deform under shared guards.

environment.browser_control: Fresh CLI headless Chrome process and profile, owned loopback server and tab; no CUA, desktop/accessibility, user-tab, or physical-device control.
environment.rendering: WebGL2 with actual 4x MSAA in every case; unmasked GPU renderer was not separately captured in this suite.
environment.timing_scope: Correctness run overlapped root workspace tests. No CPU/GPU latency or throughput claim is derived from these traces.

fixtures.creation: Independently authored grayscale rows encoded by Node stdlib zlib; no downloaded artwork or commercial fixtures. PNG byte hashes here are the actual browser-tested files; earlier Python encoding of the same asymmetric rows has a different compressed-byte hash.

oversized.expected: Reject without replacing the current brush alpha or mesh

fixtures.surface: Fresh deterministic Mesh::sphere(6), 40,962 vertices / 81,920 triangles in each case; complete initial and final .obrush outputs are preserved and hashed in case records.

checks: Known authored bilinear pixel values and RGBA opacity.
Alpha dimension/length validation and immutable shared clone allocation.
Backward-default settings, white alpha, and no-alpha geometry equality.
Pressure 0/.25/1 measurable linear response; pressure-radius and strength toggle.
Authored X/Y gradients and 90-degree rotation with known world orientation.
Mirrored original tangent and bitangent including asymmetric vertical pixels; seam not double-strength.
Known Paint channel weights, fully protected pixels, unchanged geometry/masks.
Every brush is an exact no-op for zero/nonfinite pressure or all-black alpha without history consumption.

Mixed pressure/alpha Draw stroke keeps fully masked point and old vertex colors/masks exact; new attribute interpolation remains bounded; single whole-stroke undo/redo restores geometry, topology, normals, masks, and colors.
Draw/Clay/Inflate/Flatten/Crease remain useful with adaptive_detail=false, keep topology/attributes, and undo/redo exactly.

limits: Physical pen/tablet pressure, calibration, tilt, eraser, multi-pointer behavior, and native GUI input have not been device-tested. Native force handling is conditional on the backend supplying egui Touch force.

Nine stationary samples verify current scalar response and upload/control/history contracts. Long pressure ramps, arbitrary event rates, and complete raw-sample replay are separate gates; accepted dabs capture settings while the host may coalesce old input under load.
Alphas sample existing vertices and bounded local refinement. Accepting 1024 pixels does not establish 1024 pixels of geometric detail per stamp; high-frequency patterns can alias on sparse meshes.

Non-square raster images map to a square stamp plane; grayscale 8-bit only. No UV/textures, tiling/noise, direction-following strokes, 16-bit height preservation, vector displacement, or ZBrush preset compatibility.
Brush alpha images and brush presets are not persisted in .obrush projects by this milestone; saved geometry is persisted.
Existing masks/RGB protection is verified in shared core tests; this runtime suite uses fresh unmasked uniform-color spheres. It does not establish complete PolyPaint or material parity.
Native geometry shares the same pure core; a WASM build or synthetic browser pen event does not prove native tablet usability.
